units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64">Gen. R. s. 64</cite> (v. <cite ref="C01394"><he>גָּרַר</he> II</cite>) <he>שנכנסו … והיו מְקַרְקְרִין בו וכ׳</he> lawless people came to his house and revelled with him (Abimelech) the whole night; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 111">Yalk. ib. 111</cite>.
